correctness.rationale: For odd factor sizes, idempotent all-ones operators yield exactly h0,h1 parity eigenspace multiplicities. For even sizes, each all-ones operator has one length-two nilpotent summand and the sum has exact rank (V-C)/2 by an explicit contracting homotopy on each nontrivial tensor block. The two-row matrix satisfies T^2=AT+I; on the scalar-zero primary summand T^4=I and on the scalar-one summand T^3=diag(A,A), T^6=I. Direct kernel dimensions give all fixed-point exponents and Möbius inversion the primitive census. Positivity of h0,h1 and even-coordinate rank proves sharp order twelve. Independently replayed direct enumeration for 266576 states and matrix ranks for nineteen families agree; this is ancillary to the proof.

value.rationale: The exact primitive-orbit census over every mixed-parity Hamming graph and every finite characteristic-two field addresses natural temporal recurrence and a sharp resonant period, not a small parameter substitution. The mechanism is a nontrivial tensor homotopy plus even/odd spectral interaction; it yields all period populations and a concrete infinite-family invariant. The restriction to labelled waves is natural to reversible automata and explicitly specified.
